description: Summary figure: amine-supply census, substrate permissibility, orthology, and NADP cofactor pocket
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,9.2))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1.05,1], hspace=0.42, wspace=0.26)

# ---- Panel A: amine supply census ----
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
rows = [
 ("Arginine decarboxylase (speA, EC 4.1.1.19)","BT_3394",1),
 ("Arginase/ureohydrolase family (PF00491)","BT_1099",1),
 ("Agmatinase annotated (EC 3.5.3.11)","-",0),
 ("Aminopropylagmatine ureohydrolase annotated","-",0),
 ("Agmatine deiminase (EC 3.5.3.12)","-",0),
 ("N-carbamoylputrescine amidase (EC 3.5.1.53)","-",0),
 ("Ornithine decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.17)","-",0),
 ("DABA aminotransferase (ectB/dat, EC 2.6.1.76)","-",0),
 ("DABA decarboxylase (ddc, EC 4.1.1.86)","-",0),
 ("Lysine decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.18)","-",0),
 ("Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase (asd)","BT_3636",1),
 ("CASDC/CANSDC (EC 4.1.1.96)","BT_0674",1),
 ("ASA-dependent dehydrogenase (PF03435)","BT_4612",1),
 ("AdoMet decarboxylase (EC 4.1.1.50)","-",0),
 ("Spermidine synthase (EC 2.5.1.16)","-",0),
]
y=np.arange(len(rows))[::-1]
cols=["#2a7f62" if p else "#c0504d" for _,_,p in rows]
axA.barh(y,[1]*len(rows),color=cols,height=0.72)
for yy,(lab,loc,p) in zip(y,rows):
    axA.text(0.02,yy,lab,va="center",ha="left",fontsize=8.3,color="white",fontweight="bold")
    axA.text(0.985,yy,loc if p else "absent",va="center",ha="right",fontsize=8.3,color="white")
axA.set_xlim(0,1); axA.set_yticks([]); axA.set_xticks([])
axA.set_title("A  Amine-supply gene census, B. thetaiotaomicron VPI-5482\n(UniProt proteome UP000001414, 4782 entries)",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
axA.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color="#2a7f62",label="encoded"),mpatches.Patch(color="#c0504d",label="not annotated in genome")],
           loc="lower center",bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,-0.13),ncol=2,fontsize=8,frameon=False)

# ---- Panel B: which candidate substrates the supply permits ----
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1]); axB.axis("off")
axB.set_title("B  What the amine supply permits and excludes",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
tab = [
 ["Candidate amine","Required precursor enzyme","Status"],
 ["Agmatine","arginine decarboxylase BT_3394","PERMITTED"],
 ["Putrescine","agmatinase (arginase family)","POSSIBLE: only BT_1099,\nspecificity unknown"],
 ["Putrescine (via ODC)","ornithine decarboxylase","EXCLUDED"],
 ["1,3-diaminopropane","DABA-AT + DABA decarboxylase","EXCLUDED"],
 ["Cadaverine","lysine decarboxylase","EXCLUDED"],
]
colors=[["#e8e8e8"]*3]+[["white","white",c] for c in ["#bfe3d4","#ffe9b0","#f3c4c0","#f3c4c0","#f3c4c0"]]
t=axB.table(cellText=tab,cellColours=colors,loc="upper center",cellLoc="left",colWidths=[0.27,0.38,0.35])
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(8.3); t.scale(1,2.0)
axB.text(0,0.12,"Consequence: carboxynorspermidine (needs 1,3-diaminopropane) is\nexcluded by the genome. Carboxyspermidine vs carboxyaminopropyl-\nagmatine is NOT separated, because the single ureohydrolase BT_1099\nis required by either route (upstream agmatinase, or downstream\naminopropylagmatine hydrolysis).",fontsize=8.6,va="top")

# ---- Panel C: ortholog identity ----
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
labels=["B. fragilis\nI9VY56 (PDB 8DEB)","B. fragilis NCTC9343\nQ5LG37","W. succinogenes\nQ7MSS8 (4INA)","S. pneumoniae D39\nA0A0H2ZP94 (4RL6)","B. viridis HSS\nO32323"]
vals=[96.7,97.0,61.2,56.4,22.5]
bars=axC.bar(range(5),vals,color=["#2a7f62","#2a7f62","#6b9ac4","#6b9ac4","#999999"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): axC.text(i,v+1.5,f"{v:.1f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
axC.set_xticks(range(5)); axC.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.6)
axC.set_ylabel("% identity to BT_4612 (global NW, BLOSUM62)")
axC.set_ylim(0,110)
axC.set_title("C  BT_4612 has no paralogue in its own genome;\nits closest characterised relative is 96.7% identical",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
axC.text(0.02,0.80,"Proteome-wide search (4782 proteins, 4-mer prefilter +\nSmith-Waterman): best non-self score 54 vs self-score 2167\n= no second candidate dehydrogenase in B. theta.",
         transform=axC.transAxes,fontsize=8.2,va="top",bbox=dict(fc="#f5f5f5",ec="#cccccc"))

# ---- Panel D: cofactor pocket ----
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
cont=[("R35",2.03),("K39",2.21),("T36",2.49),("S34",4.04),("K286",4.47)]
axD.barh(range(5)[::-1],[c[1] for c in cont],color="#3f6f9f",height=0.6)
axD.set_yticks(range(5)[::-1]); axD.set_yticklabels([f"{c[0]}  (identical in BT_4612)" for c in cont],fontsize=9)
axD.axvline(4.5,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); axD.set_xlabel("minimum distance to NADP 2'-phosphate (A), PDB 8DEB chain A")
axD.set_xlim(0,5.2)
axD.set_title("D  Cofactor: NADP, not NAD\n33/33 NADP-contacting residues of 8DEB identical in BT_4612",fontsize=10.5,loc="left")
axD.text(0.33,0.12,"No acidic residue at the beta-2 C-terminus (Ala33);\nbasic S34-R35-T36...K39 cluster binds the 2'-phosphate.\nBT_4612 1-40: MGRVLIIGAGGVGTVVAHKVAQNADVFTDIMIASRTKEKC",
         transform=axD.transAxes,fontsize=8,va="top",bbox=dict(fc="#f5f5f5",ec="#cccccc"))
plt.show()
print("done")
